thread: sam (Design): quick design check — added inline tooltips to the new Create API key modal for first-time users. screenshot: https://imgur.com/abc123 — wondering about order, CTA density, and aria announcements. jules (Frontend): looks nice. small ask: can we avoid stacking too many CTAs above the fold? the primary 'Copy secret' + 'Done' + 'Download' sits crowded. lee (A11y): agree on density. keyboard users should be able to tab straight to the secret and the copy button. Right now the tooltip focus trap might steal focus. marta (Product): how often do support folks see users missing the secret? ken — any data? ken (Support): yes — ~30% of tickets last month were 'lost key' because users clicked Done. They expected a persistent drawer. sam (Design): thanks — proposal: reorder so sequence is: 1) secret visible + copy button (focused), 2) download CTA, 3) done/dismiss. Tooltips briefly point at the copy button and then the download. Also add a small inline hint: "You won't be able to view this secret again." jules (Frontend): ok. technically we should ensure the secret input has aria-describedby that points to the hint, and set focus to the copy button on open. Example snippet I can add: ```html You won't be able to view this secret again. ``` lee (A11y): don't use aria-live for the initial message; use polite announcements only when the user triggers copy. For toast after copy: aria-live=\"assertive\" is okay but include clear copy: "API key copied to clipboard" and separate screen-reader-only text for the soft warning: "This secret will not be shown again." sam (Design): good call. Also thinking about contrast for the download icon — low contrast on dark bg was flagged in the mock. We should raise the icon color to AA. marta (Product): can we tighten the toast copy? current draft: "Key created — copy it now, you won't be able to see it later." Maybe shorter: "API key created. Copy now — you won't see it again." ken (Support): prefer explicit: "Copy now — this key can't be viewed again." less modal-y language. jules (Frontend): implementation note: for keyboard flow, after copy, maintain focus on the copy button and announce the toast. If the user presses Tab, they should go to Download, then Done. We'll avoid auto-closing modal for screen reader users for ~3s. lee (A11y): add a skip link at the top of the modal for experienced users to bypass tooltips: "Skip walkthrough" with tabindex=0. Also ensure tooltip elements are reachable via keyboard and have role=\"tooltip\" + aria-hidden toggles. sam (Design): love the skip link. Visual tweak: make the tooltip arrow smaller and reduce spacing so it doesn't overlap the secret field. jules (Frontend): I'll prototype the focus + aria-changes. quick code for toast announcement: ```js announce('API key copied to clipboard', { level: 'assertive' }) ``` marta (Product): sounds like an action plan. Sam — can you update the mocks with the reorder + skip link? Jules — can you add the aria snippet to the PR and flag lee for review? Ken: we'll add a KB note to reduce support tickets. sam (Design): will update mocks by EOD and include copy variants. jules (Frontend): starting a branch now, will ping @lee when ready for accessibility review. deploy-bot: build queued for branch \"feat/key-modal-accessibility\" — build 7821 started. :shipit: ken (Support): I'll draft KB text and include the exact toast wording options. lee (A11y): thanks — I'll review once PR is up. small nit: ensure tooltip background meets 4.5:1 with text. sam (Design): thanks all. will post updated screenshot when done. :thumbsup:
